data: Which of the answer types shows the largest increase in accuracy during training?

The question asks which answer type shows the largest increase in accuracy during training. From the caption, we know that the top graph represents accuracy during training (solid lines) and chance level (dashed lines) per answer type. The bottom graph represents normalized informative scores per answer type, averaged over 10k questions.

Looking at the top graph, we can see that the blue line (count) shows the steepest upward trend compared to other answer types. This indicates that the count answer type has the largest increase in accuracy during training. The other answer types show more gradual increases or remain relatively flat throughout the training process.

Therefore, the answer is "count".
